headline: NIFTY Bank hits record high on strong earnings
text: NIFTY Bank index surged to a new all-time high today, gaining 2.8% as major banks reported exceptional quarterly results. HDFC Bank, ICICI Bank, and Axis Bank all beat analyst expectations with strong loan growth and improved margins.

headline: IT sector shows resilience despite global headwinds
text: NIFTY IT demonstrated resilience today, rising 1.2% despite concerns over global tech spending. TCS and Infosys provided positive outlook for digital transformation projects.

headline: FMCG companies report strong rural demand
text: NIFTY FMCG gained 1.5% as companies reported strong rural demand recovery. HUL and Britannia saw significant volume growth in rural markets.
